hurricane: Confirm partner capacity pledges (cots, meals, generators, accessible vehicles, interpreters) and the list of sites usable for wind; refresh priority-outreach tracts.
NOAA NWS / Central Pacific Hurricane Center
Contact priority tracts (power-dependent, no-vehicle, limited English); confirm which shelters will open, generator power for medical devices, and accessible transport.
NOAA NWS / Central Pacific Hurricane Center
Open shelters including AFN-capable sites; start accessible transport for residents without vehicles; send pre-approved multilingual messages.
Feeding, re-power for medical devices, recovery sheltering for displaced households; coordinate donations and volunteers.
wildfire: PRE-POSITION: identify shelters outside the highest-risk wildfire tracts, pre-arrange accessible transport and pet space, approve multilingual evacuation templates, confirm generator power for AFN shelters.
Alert priority tracts; stage accessible transport; confirm shelter staffing and pet space.
Open shelters/refuge outside the fire area; run accessible transport; issue multilingual messages through all channels.
Recovery sheltering, feeding, mental health support, donations and volunteer management.
tsunami: PRE-POSITION: confirm shelters/refuge outside the tsunami evacuation zone (and extreme zone), transport plan for no-vehicle residents inside the zone, pre-approved multilingual evacuation messages.
Evacuate the zone; open refuge outside the zone; prioritize residents who cannot evacuate on their own.
Shelter displaced households, feeding, power for medical devices, donations and volunteers.
inland_flood: Mark shelters inside a FEMA Special Flood Hazard Area or zone D for site check; choose alternates.
Open only shelters outside the SFHA; accessible transport where roads allow; multilingual messages.
Recovery sheltering and feeding for displaced households.
coastal_flood: Mark coastal shelters in V/A zones for site check; choose inland alternates.
Alert priority coastal tracts; confirm inland shelters and transport.
Recovery sheltering and feeding for displaced households.
